claim: The source article reports average PSNR 45.5 dB, SSIM 0.9837, BER 0.0020, and NCC 0.9951
allowed_wording: Kumar et al. report the listed headline averages

claim: The independent P0 reconstruction is executable and deterministic
minimum_evidence: Passing tests, CI, config, and provenance
allowed_wording: The repository provides an audited independent reconstruction

claim: P0 is numerically equivalent to the authors' implementation
minimum_evidence: Author code or complete transform, datatype, subband, and attack parameters
A separate key-based construction, threat model, and security analysis
allowed_wording: AP/GP/HP is retained for traceability as a deterministic mapping

claim: DIGITAL_A_D format v1 is bit-exact and deterministic
minimum_evidence: Bitstream, RS, CRC, seed, permutation, and round-trip tests
allowed_wording: Format v1 round-trips exactly before channel corruption

claim: C0-C3 execute under the Haar control
minimum_evidence: Transform audit and deterministic clean integration tests
allowed_wording: C0-C3 are executable under an orthonormal Haar engineering control
prohibited_wording: The Haar result is contourlet evidence

claim: The Python directional proxy supports clean 222360-bit recovery at 45 dB
minimum_evidence: Recorded clean failure and transform audit
allowed_wording: The current proxy failed the locked clean recovery requirement
prohibited_wording: The proxy was silently replaced or tuned until it passed

claim: The MATLAB PDFB Stage-0 audit and validator are implemented
minimum_evidence: Audit script, validator tests, CLI smoke, and CI
allowed_wording: A fail-closed external PDFB audit is implemented

claim: The explicit MATLAB PDFB profile passes Stage 0
minimum_evidence: Raw runtime evidence, matching hashes, gate pass, and human review
prohibited_wording: The profile is validated or author-equivalent

claim: Adaptive allocation and power improve recovery
minimum_evidence: Locked C0/C1/C2/C3 data and corrected A-main analysis
allowed_wording: Under the locked protocol the estimated A effect was ...

minimum_evidence: Locked C0/C1/C2/C3 data and corrected D-main analysis
allowed_wording: Under the locked protocol the estimated D effect was ...

claim: A and D have a beneficial interaction
minimum_evidence: Locked factorial interaction estimate, interval, and corrected test
allowed_wording: The A-by-D interaction under the locked protocol was ...
prohibited_wording: A and D prove synergistic security

claim: C3 improves attack-averaged effective unrecovered-bit rate over C0
minimum_evidence: Primary aggregate, mean improvement at least 0.01, CI lower bound above zero, p below 0.05, and clean gate
allowed_wording: C3 improved recovery under the preregistered digital protocol

claim: C3 is superior to the source article method
minimum_evidence: Approved harmonized transform, payload, data, attacks, metrics, and qualified reconstruction
allowed_wording: C3 outperformed our explicit reconstruction under the harmonized protocol
prohibited_wording: C3 proved the paper wrong or reproduced and beat the authors

claim: A+D is technically novel relative to the closest prior art
minimum_evidence: Dated search, closest-method claim chart, precise mechanism, and ablations
allowed_wording: Within the documented search scope we found no prior method with ...

claim: Deterministic scrambling and interleaving provide cryptographic secrecy
minimum_evidence: A separate standard key-based design and security evaluation
allowed_wording: Scrambling and interleaving provide deterministic transport randomization
prohibited_wording: The payload is encrypted or unbreakable

claim: DIGITAL_A_D is robust to rotation and crop
minimum_evidence: Prospectively specified synchronization or registration, locked attacks, and results
allowed_wording: Rotation and crop are P0 stress tests only
prohibited_wording: The digital method is geometrically robust

claim: A published result can be regenerated from archived evidence
minimum_evidence: Persistent code, manifests, acquisition instructions, raw rows, environment, and analysis package
allowed_wording: The release is reproducible from the archived package
prohibited_wording: The paper is reproducible without the required data or runtime
